applicability: The intent-review sidebar filter over the subjects and locations admitted by the active Changed or All view.
conditions: A matching family id or title keeps that family's members of the active view.
A matching subject id, title or recorded effect keeps its changed-location rows.
Location matching includes changed, unchanged and not-comparable locations; a folded match keeps its subject and matching group row reachable in the reading column.
The filter narrows tree rows only; it does not alter the reading column's model, sort or block identities.
An empty result states that nothing matches.
exclusions: Searching full guarantee or statement bodies rather than the subject title.
Including subjects outside the active view merely because their location text matches.
Expanding a folded location into source cards inside the tree.
statement: The sidebar filter matches each shown subject's id, title and effect and each location's path, symbol and role within the active view.
